findings.text: test_copies_every_skill contains a vacuous assertion `sorted(p.name for p in dest.iterdir()) is not None` (always true), so no exact-set check runs there; only test_default_target_is_gemini_config_skills compares the destination listing exactly, and no test asserts the count of 26 (both compare against whatever dist/skills currently holds). The PowerShell/bash scripts' 'Copied N skills' count is never asserted.

No test or documented verification step proves Antigravity skill listing discovers the copied skills under ~/.gemini/config/skills/; tests only check files exist on disk (SKILL.md per skill). This AC is a manual/IDE check with no recorded evidence in the diff.
